dismissed.why: In this pack an anatomy part's required means the package always renders it (agent-pack/README.md, Decisions: false for an optional prop or slot). label is an optional prop, and DropdownInput renders no label row without it, so the part is not always present; FormField's and FormUpload's labels are recorded the same way. The guide's "Every field has a label." is kept as advice in /configuration/0 and the Keep a visible label pair.
